title: Algeria at the World Cup
description: From the Anfa scandal to scaring Germany in 2014 — Algeria's World Cup story is full of injustice and triumph.

questions.q: Algeria famously beat West Germany 2–1 at the 1982 World Cup in one of the biggest upsets in history. Which player scored for Algeria?
questions.explain: Rabah Madjer and Lakhdar Belloumi both scored as Algeria beat West Germany 2–1 in Gijón — one of the greatest World Cup upsets. The win counts even more given what followed in that tournament.

questions.q: Algeria's famous 1982 win over West Germany was ultimately worthless — why?
options: Algeria were disqualified for fielding an ineligible player
West Germany and Austria played a match that eliminated Algeria with a suspicious 1–0 scoreline
Algeria were found to have used banned substances
Algeria withdrew from the remaining group games
questions.explain: In the final group game, West Germany and Austria played out a 1–0 result that eliminated Algeria on goal difference. The match — known as the 'Disgrace of Gijón' — led directly to FIFA changing the rules so final group games are now played simultaneously.

questions.q: At the 2014 World Cup, Algeria beat which European nation 4–2 in the group stage?
questions.explain: Algeria beat Russia 4–2 in their final group match to advance to the round of 16 for the first time since 1982 — a 32-year wait. It was a statement win for African football.

questions.q: Algeria came incredibly close to beating Germany in the 2014 World Cup round of 16. What was the final score?
questions.explain: Germany needed extra time to beat Algeria 2–1, with goals from Mesut Özil and André Schürrle. Islam Slimani had equalised for Algeria. Germany went on to win the World Cup — Algeria had pushed them all the way.

questions.q: Riyad Mahrez is Algeria's star player. Which Premier League club did he win the league title with?
questions.explain: Riyad Mahrez won multiple Premier League titles with Manchester City under Pep Guardiola, having previously won the title at Leicester City in their miraculous 2015–16 campaign — one of sport's greatest fairytales.

questions.q: Algeria won the Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) for the second time in which year?
questions.explain: Algeria won the 2019 AFCON in Egypt, beating Senegal 1–0 in the final. Mahrez scored a stunning free-kick winner. It was their first title since 1990 and a breakthrough moment for this golden generation.

questions.q: What is Algeria's national team nickname?
questions.explain: Algeria are known as the Desert Foxes — a reference to the famous WWII Desert Fox Erwin Rommel? No — the nickname pre-dates that and simply refers to the fennec fox, native to the Algerian desert. The fennec is also Algeria's national animal.

questions.q: Which Algerian player, who played for Liverpool and Aston Villa, was part of the 2014 World Cup squad?
questions.explain: Sofiane Feghouli was a key player in Algeria's 2014 World Cup campaign, playing for Valencia at the time. He scored Algeria's first penalty in the group stage against Belgium.

questions.q: Algeria's first World Cup appearance was in 1982. Which confederation do they represent?
questions.explain: Algeria are members of CAF — the Confederation of African Football. They have represented Africa at multiple World Cups: 1982, 1986, 2010, 2014 and 2026.

questions.q: Algeria's 2010 World Cup ended with a famous 91st-minute goal against them. Who scored it to send the USA through instead?
questions.explain: Landon Donovan scored in the 91st minute to give the USA a 1–0 win, topping Group C ahead of England on goal difference and eliminating Algeria. It was one of the 2010 World Cup's most dramatic moments.
